title.purpose: One page title per page (.rs-title, Figma Heading/H2).

subheading.purpose: Group labels inside a region (.rs-subheading, Heading/H5).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action of a region (sl-button variant="primary"). PREVIEW ONLY: in pages use the sl-* component, never this native markup.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 500 14px/34px Inter, sans-serif; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: #0e6a81; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #0e6a81; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0c5264; border-color: #0c5264; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #024050; border-color: #024050; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e6a81; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary action (sl-button default). PREVIEW ONLY: in pages use the sl-* component, never this native markup.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { font: 500 14px/34px Inter, sans-serif; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: #fff; color: #2d3539; border: 1px solid #cbd0d2; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsl(192 60% 10% / 6%); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-default:hover { background: #f8f9f9; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field with the label above it (sl-input). PREVIEW ONLY: in pages use the sl-* component, never this native markup.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; color: #2d3539; } .ds-field input { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #889196; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; font: inherit; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #6c767b; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 2px solid #0e6a81; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #16a0c2; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The standard panel surface (sl-card). PREVIEW ONLY: in pages use the sl-* component, never this native markup.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e3e6e8; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsl(192 60% 10% / 6%); padding: 20px; font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; color: #414a4e; } .ds-card h4 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; color: #1f2529; }

narrative.overview: Sober, precise tools for engineers and document controllers who spend whole days in them. Density comes from order, colour belongs to the data, and surfaces are quiet tonal layers. Components and tokens are the vocabulary: screens are composed from them, never restyled.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Rule
rules.body: Semantic colours mark outcomes and states, never the difference between buttons; every state also has a label.

rules.name: The Rare Teal Rule
rules.body: At most one primary action per region.

rules.name: The Identifier-First Rule
rules.body: The readable document identifier comes first and in bold; metadata goes beneath it.

rules.name: The Quiet Panel Rule
rules.body: No shadow on shadow or panel on panel; group with the sunken surface, a divider or spacing.

dos: Do compose screens only from sl-* components and documented variants
Do take spacing only from tokens
Do keep every legacy datum and action
Do limit motion to state feedback (150/250ms)
donts: Don't use semantic colour to distinguish buttons
Don't add surfaces to layout wrappers
Don't hardcode colour or spacing outside tokens or restyle via ::part
Don't add decorative animation, gradients, illustrations or new typefaces
